name: gh-inbox-tts
description: Reads gh-inbox's GitHub notices aloud through tts, filtered by kind, repository and whose activity it was.

kinds.title: GitHub TTS: Kinds read
kinds.description: Comma-separated kinds of notice to read: comment, review, commit, ci, merge, close, branch, open, push. Empty: every kind.

repos.title: GitHub TTS: Repositories read
repos.description: Comma-separated repositories to read, each as owner/repo, host/owner/repo or its /inbox repo alias. Empty: every repository, the branch's pull request included.

readSelf.title: GitHub TTS: Read my own activity
readSelf.description: Also read notices of what the account gh is logged in as did (shown when gh-inbox's 'Notify my own activity' is on, and for merges).

format.title: GitHub TTS: What is said
format.description: The text read for a notice: {text} is the line shown, {body} the same without its [alias], {label} the alias, {repo} owner/repo, {kind} and {author} the GitHub login.

interrupt.title: GitHub TTS: Interrupt
interrupt.description: Stop what tts is saying to read a notice at once. Off: it is read after what is queued.
